blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
World Action Models (WAMs) incorporate visual representations from video generation backbones to guide action prediction. Recent efficient WAMs adopt Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architectures and compute video representations once for reuse by the action expert. However, intra-expert iteration ( i.e. , multi-step action denoising) and inter-expert waiting ( i.e. , sequential execution of the video and action experts) still limit inference efficiency. To this end, we present RealtimeWAM, an extremely efficient WAM variant with one-step action generation and asynchronous inference, addressing these two bottlenecks. To reduce intra-expert iteration, we propose Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD) to address a local-global error gap: low local consistency error alone does not guarantee accurate final actions. TACD supplements local consistency with explicit supervision from the frozen teacher’s multi-step rollout endpoint, enabling accurate one-step action generation. Additionally, we propose Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP) to eliminate unnecessary expert-level waiting. It overlaps the two experts through block-wise sharing of the video KV cache, synchronizing only immediately before the corresponding action attention consumes it. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks ( e.g. , LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin) and model variants ( e.g. , Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM) demonstrate the superiority of RealtimeWAM. Notably, RealtimeWAM maintains near-lossless performance ( i.e. , < 1 % <1\% drop) across these benchmarks while delivering significant end-to-end speedup ( e.g. , ∼ 25 × \sim 25\times on H100).

blocks.zh:
世界行动模式(WAMS)纳入了视频生成主干线的可视化表现,以指导行动预测. 近期高效的WAM采用Mixture-of-Transformers(MoT)架构并计算视频演示一次,供动作专家再用. 然而,专家内部迭接(即多步动作去诺)和专家间等待(即相继执行视频和行动专家)仍然限制了推论效率. 为此,我们提出了RealtimeWAM,这是一个极为高效的WAM变体,具有一步动作生成和同步推论,解决了这两个瓶颈. 为了减少专家内部的重复,我们提议教师-安乔德一致性分解(TACD)来解决局部-全球误差:仅靠低局部一致性误差并不能保证准确的最终行动. TACD补充了当地的一致性,从被冻结的教师的多步骤推出端点得到明确的监督,从而能够准确地产生一步骤行动。 此外,我们提议跨专家波前管道,以消除不必要的专家级等待。 它通过以区块方式共享视频KV缓存来与两位专家相重叠,仅在相应动作注意力消耗之前同步. 跨越不同基准(如:LIBERO,LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin)和模型变体(如:快活-WAM和快活-WAM)的广泛实验显示了实时WAM的优越性. 值得注意的是,实时WAM保持几乎无损失的性能(即: < 1% < 1 > 下降)跨越这些基准,同时提供重大的端到端加速(如:\\ 25\\\ sim 25\tims on H100).

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World Action Models (WAMs) ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Bi et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation by jointly modeling future visual observations and robot actions. Unlike conventional Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models ( Shukor et al., 2025 ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Bjorck et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) that map visual observations and language instructions directly to actions, WAMs incorporate future visual prediction as an additional learning objective. This supervision encourages policies to capture the physical dynamics and temporal structure of robot–environment interactions.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模式(WAMS)(袁克等,2026;叶克等,2026;毕克等,2026;李克等,2026a;金克等,2026;赵克等,2026)通过联合建模未来视觉观测和机器人行动,成为机器人操纵的有希望的模式. 与常规Vision-Language-Action(VLA)模型(Shukor等,2025;Intelligence等,2025;Kim等,2024;Bjorck等,2025;Black等,2024;Liu等,2025)不同的是,这些模型将视觉观测和语言指示直接映射到行动上,WAMs将未来的视觉预测作为一个额外的学习目标. 这种监督鼓励采取政策,掌握机器人-环境相互作用的物理动态和时间结构。

blocks.en: Based on whether video and action modeling use the same network, WAM architectures can be broadly divided into two categories. Representative shared-backbone WAMs ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) jointly denoise video and action tokens within a single backbone. Consequently, iterative denoising of long token sequences through the heavy video backbone increases inference latency. In contrast, some efficient Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT)-based WAMs ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) offer a promising alternative: the video expert computes representations once , while a separate action expert reuses them for action generation.
blocks.zh: 基于视频和动作模型是否使用同一网络,WAM架构可以大致分为两类. 具有代表性的共享后骨WAMs(Kim等,2026;Ye等,2026)在一个主干内联合出演视频和动作符. 因此,通过沉重的视频主干线迭代地去除长号序列会增加推论延迟. 相形之下,一些高效的转换器混合(MoT)基于WAMs(袁克等,2026;赵克等,2026)提供了一个很有希望的替代方案:视频专家计算一次表达,而单独的动作专家则将其再用来产生动作.

blocks.en: Despite advancements in inference pipeline design, these MoT-based WAMs still incur substantial latency. Specifically, even on advanced GPUs ( e.g. , H100 in Fig. 1 ), these models ( e.g. , Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) ) require over 300 ms for a single inference call. We identify two inference bottlenecks that remain insufficiently addressed in existing MoT-based WAMs: ➀ Intra-expert iteration arises from multi-step action denoising. We observe that the action expert accounts for nearly 90% of end-to-end latency for action generation across diverse GPUs (see Fig. 1 ). ➁ Inter-expert waiting stems from sequential execution of the video and action experts. As shown in Fig. 4 (a), the action expert begins execution only after the video expert completes its forward pass, causing unnecessary waiting.
blocks.zh: 尽管在推论管道设计上有所进步,但这些基于MOT的WAM仍然有很大的延迟. 具体来说,即使是在先进的GPU上(如图1中的H100),这些模型(如快取WAM). (Yuan等,2026)需要300多ms的单次推论呼叫. 我们找出了两个在现有的基于技术部的WAM中仍未得到充分解决的推论瓶颈:QQ 专家内部迭接来自多步骤行动去名化。 我们观察到,动作专家在各种GPU的动作生成中占了近90%(见图1)。 专家之间的等待源于视频和行动专家的相继执行。 如图4(a)所示,行动专家只有在视频专家完成前传后才开始行刑,造成不必要的等待.

blocks.en: Motivated by the above analysis, we present RealtimeWAM , an extremely efficient post-trained variant based on any MoT-based WAM. To our knowledge, it is the first one-step WAM to achieve near-lossless performance compared with its multi-step counterparts.
blocks.zh: 基于上述分析,我们提出了实时WAM(RealtimeWAM),这是一个基于基于任何基于MOT的WAM的极为高效的后训练变体. 据我们所知,与多步骤同行相比,这是第一个实现近乎无损失业绩的一步WAM。

blocks.en: To combat intra-expert iteration, we propose Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD) for one-step action generation. TACD addresses a local-global error gap in conventional consistency distillation, which only constrains local consistency while neglecting to explicitly penalize the global target action error. TACD adopts the frozen teacher’s multi-step rollout endpoint as a numerical proxy for the exact clean endpoint, explicitly aligning the student’s velocity prediction with the corresponding interval-averaged teacher velocity. From a theoretical perspective, we show that this teacher anchor directly constrains the total endpoint error, complementing local consistency supervision with an explicit action endpoint constraint.
blocks.zh: 为了防止专家内部的重复,我们建议教师-教师一致性分解(TACD)为一步步行动。 TACD解决了常规一致性分解中局部-全球误差,这只会限制局部一致性,而忽略明确惩罚全球目标动作出错. TACD 采用被冻结的教师多步骤推出的端点作为精确的干净端点的数字代名词,明确将学生的速度预测与相应的间隔平均教师速度相配合. 从理论角度看,我们显示,这个师资主锚直接制约了总的端点出错,用一个明确的动作端点限制来补充局部一致性监督.

blocks.en: To reduce inter-expert waiting, we introduce Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP), which transforms coarse expert-wise execution into a fine-grained block-wise pipeline. Under conventional expert-wise execution, the Action Expert waits for the Video Expert to construct the complete block-wise KV cache. We first conduct an in-depth dependency analysis, observing that each action block requires the video KV cache only from its corresponding video block, rather than the complete output of the Video Expert. Motivated by this observation, CEWP overlaps the execution of the two experts through block-wise sharing of the video KV cache, synchronizing only immediately before the corresponding action attention consumes it, which significantly reduces unnecessary waiting.
blocks.zh: 为了减少专家之间的等待,我们引入了跨专家波前管道(CEWP),它将粗糙的专家执行转变为精细的分块式管道. 根据传统的专家执行方式,行动专家等待视频专家构建完整的以块为主的KV缓存. 我们首先进行深入的依赖性分析,观察到每个动作块只需要从相应的视频块中取出视频KV缓存,而不是视频专家的完整出品. 基于这一观察的动机,CEWP通过以区块方式分享视频KV缓存来重叠两位专家的行刑,仅在相应动作注意力消耗前立即同步,这大大减少了不必要的等待.

blocks.en: RealtimeWAM achieves impressive results on representative MoT-based WAM architectures, including Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) and Faster-WAM ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , across diverse downstream benchmarks ( e.g. , LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) , and RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025 ) ). On these benchmarks, it delivers approximately 14 ∼ 25 × 14\sim 25\times inference acceleration with an average < 1 % <1\% accuracy drop compared with the original multi-step models. Notably, RealtimeWAM’s per-call inference latency is significantly shorter than the corresponding execution time ( e.g. , 30 Hz control frequency), enabling real-time action generation. These results demonstrate that RealtimeWAM remains effective across diverse robot configurations, task horizons, and distribution conditions, and provide a practical path toward efficient WAM deployment.
blocks.zh: 实时WAM在具有代表性的基于MOT的WAM架构上取得了令人印象深刻的成果,包括快取WAM(袁等,2026年)和快取WAM(赵等,2026年),跨越了不同的下游基准(如LIBERO(刘等,2023年),LIBERO-Plus(飞等,2025年)和RoboTwin 2.0(陈等,2025年)等. 在这些基准上,与最初的多步模型相比,它提供大约14 × 25 × 14\sim 25\tims的推论加速,平均 < 1% < 1-%的精度下降. 值得注意的是,实时WAM的逐个推断延迟比相应的执行时间(例如30赫兹控制频率)要快得多,能够产生实时动作. 这些结果表明,实时WAM在不同的机器人配置、任务视野和分配条件方面依然有效,并为高效WAM的部署提供了一条实用的道路。

blocks.en: To summarize, our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献如下:

blocks.en: ▶ \blacktriangleright We propose RealtimeWAM, a one-step asynchronous WAM that addresses both intra-expert iteration and inter-expert waiting in any MoT-based WAM for efficient robot manipulation. ▶ \blacktriangleright We propose Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD), which mitigates the local-global error gap by augmenting local consistency supervision with a teacher endpoint constraint for accurate one-step action generation. ▶ \blacktriangleright We introduce Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP), which reduces unnecessary synchronization by overlapping block-wise execution of the Video and Action Experts according to their data dependencies. ▶ \blacktriangleright Extensive experiments demonstrate that RealtimeWAM achieves real-time action generation with < 1 % <1\% accuracy degradation ( i.e. , 12.2 ms inference latency with ∼ 25 × \sim 25\times speedup on an NVIDIA H100 GPU).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 World Action Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 世界行动模式

blocks.en: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models ( Shukor et al., 2025 ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Bjorck et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) rely on pretrained vision-language backbones to map visual observations and language instructions directly to actions, World Action Models (WAMs) ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Bi et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) incorporate future visual representations from video generation backbones to guide action prediction. Modern WAMs can be broadly classified into two categories. ➀ One line of work focuses on shared-backbone WAMs, which model future video and robot actions within a shared backbone, including DreamZero ( Ye et al., 2026 ) and Cosmos ( Kim et al., 2026 ) . ➁ In contrast, Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT)-based WAMs, such as Motus ( Bi et al., 2026 ) , employ separate video and action experts that interact through attention. Among these methods, Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) reduces inference overhead by computing video representations once for reuse by the action expert. Subsequent works, including Light-WAM ( Li et al., 2026c ) and Faster-WAM ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , further improve computational efficiency and out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness. Nevertheless, these methods may incur substantial performance degradation on challenging benchmarks or achieve limited speedups.
blocks.zh: 虽然Visual-Langage-Action(VLA)模型(Shukor等,2025;Intelligence等,2025;Kim等,2024;Bjorck等,2025;Black等,2024;Liu等,2025;Wang等,2026b;郑等,2026)依靠经过预先培训的视觉观测和语言指令直接映射行动,但World Action Models(WAMs)(袁等,2026;Ye等,2026;Bi等,2026;Li等,2026a)吸收了未来视频生成主干线的视觉表现,指导行动预测. 现代WAM可以大致分为两类. ➀. 一行的工作重点是共享后骨WAMs,它模拟了未来在共享骨干范围内的视频和机器人动作,包括DreamZero(Ye等,2026年)和Cosmos(Kim等,2026年). 相形之下,基于Motus(Bi等,2026年)的Mixture-of-Transfers(MoT)的WAM则使用单独的视频和行动专家,通过关注进行互动. 在这些方法中,Fast-WAM(Yuan等,2026年)通过计算一次视频表达供动作专家再用,来减少推论间接费用. 随后的作品有"光明-WAM"(Li等,2026c)和"快活-WAM"(Zhao等,2026)等,进一步提高了计算效率和分配外(OOD)稳健性. 然而,这些方法可能会在具有挑战性的基准上出现严重性能退化,或达到有限的速度。

blocks.en: 2.2 Few-Step Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.2 几步分解

blocks.en: Diffusion models ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2020 ) and flow models ( Lipman et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Albergo et al., 2023 ) have become cornerstones of modern high-quality image and video generation. However, their iterative sampling cost has motivated a series of few-step acceleration methods, including progressive distillation ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ) , consistency models ( Song et al., 2023 ) , distribution matching distillation ( Yin et al., 2024 ) , MeanFlow ( Geng et al., 2025 ) , and adversarial distillation ( Sauer et al., 2024 ) . These distillation techniques have recently been introduced into World Action Models ( Akbari et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . The work most relevant to ours is Flash-WAM ( Akbari et al., 2026 ) , which identifies a modality-dependent noise-regime mismatch and introduces modality-specific consistency parameterizations. However, ➀ it focuses on few-step distillation for WAMs that retain future-video denoising during inference, such as LingBot-VA ( Li et al., 2026a ) ; and ➁ its ultra-few-step ( i.e. , one-step) distillation still exhibits noticeable performance degradation ( e.g. , RoboTwin and real-world tasks). These limitations motivate our investigation of one-step action distillation for MoT-based WAMs.
blocks.zh: 分流模型(Sohl-Dickstein等,2015年;Ho等,2020年;Song等,2020年)和流出模型(Lipman等,2022年;Liu等,2022年;Albergo等,2023年)已成现代高品质形象和视频生成的基石. 然而,它们的迭代采样成本催生出一系列几步加速方法,包括渐进式蒸馏(Salimans and Ho, 2022),一致性模型(Song等, 2023),分布相匹配蒸馏(Yin等, 2024),MeanFlow(Geng等, 2025)和对抗式蒸馏(Sauer等, 2024). 这些蒸馏技术最近被引入了"世界行动模式"(Akbari等,2026;Yang等,2026.). 与我们最相干的工作是Flash-WAM(Akbari等,2026年),它确定了一种依赖模式的噪声-调控不匹配,并引入了特定模式的一致性参数. 然而,QQ侧重于在推论中保留未来视频去诺的WAMs的几步分馏,如LingBot-VA(Li等,2026a;和QQ其超相分馏(即一步分馏)仍然表现出明显的性能退化(如RoboTwin和现实世界的任务). 这些限制促使我们对基于MOT的WAM的一步动作蒸馏进行调查。

blocks.en: 2.3 Asynchronous Inference for Robot Policies
blocks.zh: 2.3 机器人政策同步推论

blocks.en: Asynchronous inference has been widely studied for real-time robot control because it mitigates execution stalls, stale observations, and delayed responses caused by policy latency. Existing approaches can be broadly grouped into three categories: execution-level asynchrony, module-level asynchrony, and sampling-level asynchrony. Execution-level methods overlap prediction of the next action chunk with execution of the current one and maintain continuity through prefix conditioning, state correction, or chunk fusion ( Black et al., 2025a ; Black et al., 2025b ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Motubrain Team, 2026 ) . Module-level methods decouple a slow semantic or world module from a fast action module, allowing cached high-level representations to guide high-frequency action updates ( Hirose et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . Sampling-level methods assign different action positions, chunks, modalities, or denoising streams distinct sampling schedules, enabling early action output or selective refinement without waiting for full decoding ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . In contrast, RealtimeWAM employs finer-grained asynchrony at the block level, distinguishing it from prior approaches.
blocks.zh: 同步推论被广泛研究用于实时机器人控制,因为它能减轻执行摊位,收缩观察,以及因政策延迟而导致的延迟反应. 现有方法大致可分为三类:执行一级同步、模块一级同步和取样一级同步。 执行级方法将下一个动作块的预测与当前动作块的执行相重叠,并通过前缀条件、状态修正或块聚来保持连续性(Black等,2025a; Black等,2025b;Tang等,2025;Wang等,2026a;Motubrain Team,2026.). 模块级方法将一个慢语义或世界模块从快动作模块中解析出,允许缓存高层次的表示来指导高频动作更新(Hirose等,2026;Cai等,2026). 采样一级方法指定了不同的行动位置、块、模式或去除溪流不同的采样时间表,从而能够在不等待完全解码的情况下及早产生行动产出或进行选择性改进(Jiang等,2025;Lu等,2026;Li等,2026b)。 相形之下,RealtimeWAM在区块一级采用更精细的同步法,将其与以前的方法区分开来.

blocks.zh: 3 序言

blocks.en: 3.1 Efficient Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT)-based WAMs
blocks.zh: 3.1 高效的转换器混合装置

blocks.en: In this work, we propose RealtimeWAM , a one-step asynchronous world action model for post-training acceleration of any MoT-based WAM. RealtimeWAM addresses intra-expert iteration through Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (Sec. 4.1 ) and inter-expert waiting through Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (Sec. 4.2 ).

blocks.en: As discussed above, multi-step action denoising dominates inference latency (Fig. 1 ) while video latent representations are computed in a single forward pass in the Video Expert. Therefore, our target is to achieve high-quality few-step action generation (especially one-step) to combat intra-expert iteration. Recent step distillation strategies ( Song et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2024 ; Geng et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) have been extensively studied in image and video generation. However, we identify a distinctive characteristic of action generation in WAMs: denoising is strongly conditioned on visual observations, robot states, and language instructions, which can confine feasible actions ( e.g. , grasp positions and gripper commands) to a narrow range. Within this constrained action space, even subtle deviations can affect task success rates owing to the high sensitivity of robotic control to action errors.

blocks.en: However, directly applying consistency distillation to WAMs raises a significant challenge, dubbed the local-global error gap . Specifically, although consistency distillation ( Song et al., 2023 ) can effectively minimize local consistency errors, it does not considerably reduce deviations from the global target action. As shown in Fig. 3 (right), the error between the teacher’s clean action targets and student’s predictions does not decrease considerably for consistency distillation. Such large deviations from the clean action targets can induce inaccuracies in robotic control.

blocks.en: Based on this dependency analysis, we propose Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP), which transforms coarse expert-wise execution into a fine-grained block-wise wavefront across the Video and Action Experts. We assign the Video and Action Experts to two non-blocking CUDA streams, 𝒮 v \mathcal{S}_{v} and 𝒮 a \mathcal{S}_{a} , respectively. Each stream preserves program order, while a CUDA event e i e_{i} enforces the dependency at block i i : 𝒮 v : \displaystyle\mathcal{S}_{v}: 𝒫 i v → record ⁡ ( e i ) → Attn i v → ℛ i v , \displaystyle\mathcal{P}_{i}^{v}\rightarrow\operatorname{record}(e_{i})\rightarrow\operatorname{Attn}_{i}^{v}\rightarrow\mathcal{R}_{i}^{v}, (13) 𝒮 a : \displaystyle\mathcal{S}_{a}: 𝒫 i a → wait ⁡ ( e i ) → Attn i a → ℛ i a , \displaystyle\mathcal{P}_{i}^{a}\rightarrow\operatorname{wait}(e_{i})\rightarrow\operatorname{Attn}_{i}^{a}\rightarrow\mathcal{R}_{i}^{a}, where e i e_{i} signals the availability of ( K i v , V i v ) (K_{i}^{v},V_{i}^{v}) . The video stream records e i e_{i} immediately after 𝒫 i v \mathcal{P}_{i}^{v} and continues its remaining computation, while the action stream waits only before Attn i a \operatorname{Attn}_{i}^{a} (shown in Fig. 4 (b)). This late synchronization allows the action projection to proceed independently and delays cross-stream waiting until the video KV cache is actually consumed. Action blocks thus consume video KV cache entries incrementally as the video stream advances, forming a staggered wavefront along model depth.

blocks.en: 5.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 5.1 执行细节

blocks.en: We implement RealtimeWAM based on Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) and Faster-WAM ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , yielding RealtimeWAM * and RealtimeWAM † , respectively. We freeze the Video Expert and optimize only rank-128 low-rank adaptation (LoRA) ( Hu et al., 2021 ) parameters in the Action Expert. In Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD), we obtain the teacher endpoint through a 10-step rollout of the frozen teacher and set the teacher-anchored loss weight to λ = 0.2 \lambda=0.2 . Training proceeds for 30,000 iterations with AdamW, a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and a weight decay of 10 − 2 10^{-2} . We set the exponential moving average (EMA) decay to 0.995 0.995 . For a fair comparison, all evaluated step-distillation methods, including distribution matching distillation (DMD) ( Yin et al., 2024 ) , consistency distillation ( Song et al., 2023 ) , and MeanFlow distillation ( Geng et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2026 ) , adopt the same training settings. Moreover, we compare against other efficient WAMs, including Flash-WAM ( Akbari et al., 2026 ) and Light-WAM ( Li et al., 2026c ) . For latency evaluation, we include VAE encoding time but exclude text encoding time, as instructions are encoded only once per episode.

blocks.en: 5.2 Evaluation Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 5.2 评价基准

blocks.en: We evaluate RealtimeWAM on LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , and LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) , using task success rate as the evaluation metric. On LIBERO, we evaluate four task suites: Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long. For RoboTwin 2.0, we follow the multi-task training setting in previous work ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , training on 50 tasks using a total of 2,500 clean demonstrations and 25,000 randomized demonstrations. We evaluate performance under both clean and randomized conditions. To assess out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness, we further evaluate success rates on all seven perturbation subsets of LIBERO-Plus. We additionally evaluate RealtimeWAM on real-world dual-arm manipulation tasks (see Appendix F.6 ).
blocks.zh: 我们对LIBERO(Liu等人,2023年),RoboTwin 2.0(Chen等人,2025年)和LIBERO-Plus(Fei等人,2025年)进行实时WAM评价,以任务成功率作为评价的衡量标准。 在LIBERO,我们评价四个任务组:空间、物体、目标和长。 对于RoboTwin 2.0,我们遵循前作(袁等,2026年)的多任务训练设置,使用总共2500个清洁示威和25000个随机示威进行50个任务训练. 我们评价在清洁和随机条件下的业绩。 为了评估分配外稳健性,我们进一步评价LIBERO-Plus所有七个扰动子集的成功率。 此外,我们还对现实世界双臂操纵任务实时评估(见附录F.6)。

blocks.en: RoboTwin 2.0. We report detailed results on RoboTwin 2.0 (Tab. 1 ). Notably, RealtimeWAM * achieves a success rate of 90.84% with one-step action generation using only LoRA fine-tuning, incurring a reduction of just 0.67% compared with 10-step Fast-WAM. Surprisingly, RealtimeWAM † achieves nearly lossless performance with one-step action generation, attaining a success rate of 92.64% with a reduction of only 0.29% compared with 10-step Faster-WAM. It also considerably outperforms other efficient WAMs ( e.g. , 81.41% for one-step Flash-WAM) and step-distillation baselines ( e.g. , 88.22% for DMD * ).

blocks.en: LIBERO. A similar trend is observed on LIBERO (Tab. 1 ). RealtimeWAM * achieves an overall success rate of 97.0% with one-step action generation, matching the performance of 10-step Fast-WAM. Compared with directly reducing Fast-WAM to a single denoising step (95.0%), RealtimeWAM * improves the success rate by 2.0%, demonstrating the effectiveness of step distillation in preserving policy performance. It also outperforms one-step Flash-WAM (95.1%) and DMD * (96.1%), while remaining competitive with Light-WAM (97.2%). Detailed results for individual LIBERO task suites are provided in Appendix F.3 (Tab. F.1 ).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented RealtimeWAM, a post-training framework that accelerates MoT-based WAMs by addressing intra-expert iteration and inter-expert waiting. Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation complements local consistency supervision with a teacher endpoint constraint, enabling accurate one-step action generation. Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining overlaps block-wise execution of the Video and Action Experts through fine-grained synchronization, reducing unnecessary waiting. RealtimeWAM enables real-time action generation ( e.g. , 12.2 ms latency) with near-lossless policy performance on MoT-based WAMs, including Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM, while delivering significant end-to-end speedups across diverse hardwares ( e.g. , approximately 14 ∼ 25 × 14\sim 25\times on H100).
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了实时WAM,这是一个培训后框架,通过解决专家内部迭接和专家间等待问题,加快基于技术的WAM。 教师-教师一致性阻滞用教师端点限制来补充地方一致性监督,从而能够准确的一步步行动生成。 跨专家波前管道通过精细的同步来与视频与动作专家的分块执行相重叠,减少了不必要的等待. 实时WAM可以使基于MOT的WAM(包括快WAM和快WAM)上的政策性能几乎不亏不盈的实时动作生成(如: 12.2 ms latency),同时在各种硬件之间实现重要的端到端快取(如:在H100上大约为 14 ∼ 25× 14\sim 25\tim).

blocks.en: 1) Applicability. RealtimeWAM targets MoT-based WAMs and is not directly applicable to shared-backbone architectures such as DreamZero ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . Step distillation in shared-backbone WAMs more closely resembles step distillation in video generation, making action-specific characteristics harder to isolate and motivating our focus on MoT architectures. Within this scope, our framework supports both models that omit explicit future-video prediction at inference ( e.g. , Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) ) and those that retain it ( e.g. , Faster-WAM ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) ).

blocks.en: F.2 Efficient Kernel Implementation
blocks.zh: F.2 高效率的核心执行

blocks.en: We apply five operator-level optimizations to reduce kernel launches and intermediate memory traffic. (1) We fuse modulation and residual gating into separate element-wise kernels, preserving BF16 intermediate rounding while keeping LayerNorm independent. (2) We fuse each Q/K RMSNorm into a single Triton kernel, retaining FP32 statistics and BF16 intermediate rounding. (3) We fuse RoPE type conversions and complex rotation into a single Triton kernel while retaining FP64 arithmetic. (4) We replace static all-True attention masks with None , preserving masks that exclude attention positions. (5) We pack self-attention Q/K/V and cross-attention K/V projections into single GEMMs, leaving cross-attention Q separate. These optimizations complement CUDA Graph, which reduces CPU submission overhead but does not automatically fuse operators within the graph.
blocks.zh: 我们应用了5个运营商级优化,以减少内核发射和中间内存流量. (1) 将调制和剩余成分出元素的内核,保留BF16中间圆形,同时保持层核独立。 (2)将每个Q/K RMSNorm装入一个单三通内核,保留FP32统计和BF16中间圆圈. (3)在保留FP64算术的同时,将 RoPE 类型转换和复杂自转装入单一的Triton内核. (4) 我们用 " 无 " 取代静态全真注意口罩,保留排除注意位置的口罩。 (5)我们把自留Q/K/V和相取K/V的相取预测打入单个GEMM,使相取Q分开. 这些优化补充了CUDA图,它减少了CPU提交间接费用,但并不自动在图中引信操作员.

blocks.en: F.6 Real-World Evaluation of Long-Horizon Garment Folding
blocks.zh: F.6 长胡同服装装饰的真人评价

blocks.en: We qualitatively evaluate RealtimeWAM * on a real-world T-shirt-folding task using a bimanual setup comprising two PiPER robotic arms from AgileX Robotics 3 3 3 https://global.agilex.ai/products/piper , with policy inference running on an NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU. As shown in Figure F.1 , the task involves successive grasping and folding operations that transform an unfolded garment into a compact configuration. It requires temporally coordinated decisions because each fold changes the garment geometry and the grasp locations available for subsequent actions. Early misalignment can therefore affect later folds, making this task a useful setting for examining long-horizon manipulation of deformable objects.
blocks.zh: 我们利用由AgileX机器人3 3 https://global.ailex.ai/products/piper的两只PiPER机器人臂组成的双人布局,对真实世界T恤的复制任务进行实时WAM*进行质量评价,并用NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU进行政策推论。 如图F.1所示,这项工作涉及接连抓取和折叠操作,将所穿的外衣转变为紧凑的配置。 它需要时间上协调的决定,因为每个折叠会改变服装几何和可供以后行动使用的取取位置. 因此,早期的错配会影响后折叠,使这个任务成为检查可变形物体的长视距操纵的有益环境.

blocks.en: To meet the real-time requirement of this sequential setting, we deploy the RealtimeWAM * model distilled from Fast-WAM, using TACD for one-step action generation and CEWP for block-wise overlap between the Video and Action Experts. In the physical evaluation, consecutive actions proceeded without perceptible pauses, enabling smooth real-time execution even without execution-level asynchrony between policy inference and robot execution, such as Real-Time Chunking (RTC) ( Black et al., 2025a ) . The resulting low-latency inference allows the policy to maintain continuous control throughout the long-horizon folding sequence. In the context of RealtimeWAM * , this task motivates preserving action quality under one-step action generation while reducing inference overhead during sequential execution.
blocks.zh: 为了满足这种相继设置的实时要求,我们采用了从快取WAM中提炼出来的实时WAM *模型,使用TACD进行一步动作生成,而CEWP则用于视频与行动专家的分块重叠. 在物理评价中,连续的行动没有明显的暂停,即使没有执行级别,也能够顺利地实时执行政策推断和机器人执行之间的同步,如实时春金(RTC)(Black等,2025a.). 由此产生的低纬度推论使得政策能够在整个长视线折叠序列中保持持续的控制. 在实时WAM* 的背景下,这项任务激励在单步行动生成下保持行动质量,同时减少相继执行过程中的推断间接费用.
